what: National quarterly results for the 'Shorter stays in emergency departments' health target (% of ED patients admitted, discharged or transferred within six hours), from the September 2023 baseline. Each quarter is copied by hand from the DPMC Government Targets factsheet that reports it (the factsheet for a quarter carries the result of the quarter before) or from Health NZ's quarterly factsheets. There is no machine-readable series; the DPMC PDFs are not parsed at run time. At run time the feed appends any newer quarter it finds in the Health NZ national factsheet.

target.label: 95% of patients admitted, discharged or transferred from an ED within six hours
